notes: Route 1 («فقد رويته عن أبي») runs only to the compiler's father, named by relation. The book's author Husayn b. Hammad is named in the opening clause and is the last link of the chain; this is the same author-of-a-cited-book case as the sister report (rule 11), so it needs a ruling.

Routes 2 and 3 are written out in full: «و الحميري جميعا» makes al-Himyari join Muhammad b. al-Hasan and Sa'd at «أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى», after which the text writes the chain once. The shared names are repeated in both groups, since the tool expects each route in full.
The blessings «رضي اللّه عنهما» are not part of any surface.
